scenarios.title: Direct Iran-Israel strike on an IRGC position

units.text: Israeli aircraft struck an IRGC air-defense position near Kermanshah on August 8, damaging radar equipment at the site.

evidence.text: Iranian outlets acknowledged damage to radar equipment at an IRGC air-defense position near Kermanshah after a reported Israeli strike on August 8.

expected.notes: Core direct_kinetic lane case: direct Iran-Israel fighting supported by ir military evidence with governing attribution preserved (the claim reports what Iranian outlets acknowledged; matching never strengthens it).

units.text: Hezbollah launched rocket salvos at Israeli positions in the Galilee panhandle on August 8, its largest single-day volume in three weeks.

evidence.text: Hezbollah claimed rocket salvos against Israeli positions in the Galilee panhandle on August 8.

expected.notes: Lebanese-channel evidence is pinned to the ir theater lens (AGENTS.md ruling 11); theater is a coverage lens, not nationality. Hezbollah is on the iran_regional actor roster (contract section 5 predicate 4).

units.text: An Iranian-aligned Iraqi militia claimed a one-way drone attack on a base hosting US forces near Erbil on August 8; no casualties were reported.

evidence.text: An Iranian-aligned Iraqi militia claimed a one-way drone attack on a base hosting US forces near Erbil on August 8.

expected.notes: Iraqi militia activity is in-scope for iran_regional by actor roster; the claim keeps the militia's own claim-attribution (hedging stays 'claimed').

scenarios.title: Houthi anti-ship attack in the Red Sea

units.text: Houthi forces attacked a bulk carrier with anti-ship missiles southwest of Al Hudaydah on August 8; the vessel reported minor damage and continued transit.

evidence.text: A bulk carrier reportedly sustained minor damage from an anti-ship missile southwest of Al Hudaydah on August 8 and continued transit.

expected.notes: Both the Houthi actor roster (proxy_partner) and the Red Sea event geography (maritime) hit; the fixture pins the `maritime` lane by event-geography precedence. The lane tie-break rule is flagged as a contract ambiguity in the README — the P1 deterministic classifier must freeze it.

scenarios.title: IRGC Navy activity in the Strait of Hormuz near Omani waters
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: Hormuz or Gulf-base activity involving Oman/Bahrain/Qatar/UAE/Kuwait/Saudi Arabia

units.text: IRGC Navy fast boats shadowed a commercial tanker in the Strait of Hormuz near the Omani traffic corridor on August 8 before withdrawing without boarding.

evidence.text: IRGC Navy fast boats reportedly shadowed a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz near Omani waters on August 8 and withdrew without boarding.

expected.notes: Hormuz is explicitly in-scope for iran_regional (contract section 5 predicate 5); Omani-adjacent Gulf activity is a test-mandated inclusion. Evidence here is mapped ir-theater; the no-mapped-Gulf-evidence case is iran-gulf-unavailable-010.

scenarios.title: IAEA access development supported by NUCLEAR-track evidence
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: IAEA/nuclear evidence from the NUCLEAR track

units.text: The IAEA reported that Iran declined to restore agency access to an enrichment-related workshop near Natanz during an August 8 technical visit.

evidence.text: The IAEA said Iran declined to restore access to an enrichment-related workshop near Natanz during an August 8 technical visit.

expected.notes: Proves the multi-track contributor set (contract section 5 predicate 6): the nuclear track contributes to iran_regional. The legacy military-only Iran validation structurally excluded this evidence. One authoritative record supports its exact action/status (ruling 20).

scenarios.title: E3 diplomacy on IAEA monitoring access

units.text: E3 foreign ministries stated after an August 8 coordination call that they would pursue renewed UN sanctions measures unless Iran restored full IAEA monitoring access.

evidence.text: E3 governments stated on August 8 they would pursue renewed UN sanctions measures absent restored IAEA monitoring access in Iran.

expected.notes: E3/EU diplomacy is on the iran_regional actor roster and lands in nuclear_diplomacy (contract section 4: program, IAEA, E3/EU, mediators).

scenarios.title: Succession-related positioning from the ELITE track
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: Iranian domestic security or succession from the ELITE track

units.text: Media aligned with Iran's security services amplified favorable profiles of Assembly of Experts member Kazem Ravandust on August 8, coverage consistent with succession-related positioning.

evidence.text: Security-aligned Iranian media reportedly amplified favorable profiles of Assembly of Experts member Kazem Ravandust on August 8.

expected.notes: Kazem Ravandust is a FICTIONAL person (content rule; no real official is named). The elite_politics track is a designated iran_regional contributor (contract section 5 predicate 6). Hedged media-behavior attribution governs the whole assertion (rulings 19/20 spirit); matching never strengthens it.

scenarios.title: Unrelated Israeli/Gulf domestic and commercial news is excluded
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: unrelated Israeli/Gulf domestic or commercial news that must be excluded

units.text: Iranian officials publicized new air-defense exercises around Isfahan on August 8.

evidence.text: A Gulf retail conglomerate reportedly posted record quarterly earnings on August 8.
An Israeli municipal coalition dispute over local budget allocations reportedly continued on August 8.

expected.notes: Region membership never suffices (contract section 5 test-mandated exclusions): Gulf commercial earnings and Israeli municipal politics are off_scope. For 9110 both off_scope and legacy_incomparable apply; the fixture pins content-scope checks first (single bounded reason: off_scope) — exclusion-reason precedence is flagged as a contract ambiguity in the README. The in-scope exercise unit stays a genuine miss.

scenarios.title: Gulf-base lane with no comparable mapped evidence reports unavailable
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: an Iran Update lane with no comparable mapped Gulf evidence — expected `unavailable` for that lane, never manufactured

units.text: The United States augmented air defenses at a base in Bahrain during the first week of August, and Gulf-based reporting described increased interceptor stocks at the site.

evidence.text: Gulf reporting claimed increased interceptor stocks at a US-used base in Bahrain during the first week of August.

expected.independentSourceNote: The legacy bh claim IS a member of the published-retention population as a labeled `legacy` contributor (designated gulf digest), so publishedRetention is matched; it is NOT in the corpus-recall population, whose lane honestly reports unavailable.
expected.notes: Comparability honesty (contract section 5): bh has no map-stage doc_claims, so corpus recall for this lane is `unavailable` — never a manufactured zero and never a silent inclusion of legacy rows. expected.eligibility describes the corpus-recall candidate union only (README schema note). No contribution entry: contribution follows corpus-recall matched units in these fixtures.

scenarios.title: Same proxy actor in two distinct events must not cross-match
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: the same proxy/actor in two DISTINCT events (must not cross-match)

units.text: Houthi forces launched a ballistic missile toward Eilat on August 8 that Israeli air defenses intercepted.
Houthi forces detained the crew of a fishing vessel off Al Salif on August 8 and moved the crew ashore.

evidence.text: Israeli air defenses reportedly intercepted a ballistic missile launched from Yemen toward Eilat on August 8.

expected.notes: Two distinct same-day events by the same actor: the missile-interception claim matches u0 only. A matcher that pairs on shared actor (Houthi) or shared day alone would wrongly match u1 — section 6.3 requires compatible action, place, and object per event.

scenarios.title: Translated source never strengthens hedge or attribution
scenarios.acceptanceRef: Iran: source-language translation that must not strengthen hedge or attribution

units.text: Iranian security services detained several employees of a fuel-distribution company in Bandar Abbas on August 8 on sabotage allegations, according to unconfirmed local reporting.

evidence.text: Local Persian-language reporting claimed security services detained several fuel-company employees in Bandar Abbas on August 8 over sabotage allegations.

expected.notes: The claim derives from a translated fa-language source (doc.sourceLanguage) and carries hedging 'claimed' with governing attribution. Expected: the match succeeds AND the hedge stays 'claimed' — neither translation, matching, nor any conflict rendering may strengthen hedge, attribution, identity, predicate, status, or timing (contract section 6.3; ruling 20). No real person or company is named.
